content:
Gain 50% of your bonus movement speed as reload speed.

0031AEF2

Notes[]

Although the perk card art for Expert Commando depicts a R91 assault rifle, this weapon is not available in the game.

Before update 60, the perk was named "Expert Commando." It used to have 3 ranks that provided +10%/+15%/+20% damage to automatic rifles.

References[]

↑Fallout 76 Update Notes – October 21, 2025. Bethesda Game Studio (2025-10-21). Retrieved on 2025-10-21. “Fast Fighter: Now grants 50% of your movement speed above 100% (your bonus movement speed) as reload speed.”
